categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in functional textile dyeing and finishing processing, warp and circular knitting fabric weaving and sales, trade of warp and circular knitting finished fabrics, and solar power plant electricity sales. The business is diversified with a focus on high value-added functional sports fabrics and environmentally friendly textile products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include weaving, dyeing, post-processing finishing, and coating processes. The company emphasizes high automation, energy-saving, and low-carbon production methods, including the use of recycled polyester yarns certified by GRS, bio-based auxiliaries, and fluorine-free water repellents. It also integrates smart fabric inspection systems and digital energy management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are international brand apparel companies, especially in outdoor sportswear and functional fashion textiles. The company serves markets in Europe, America, and Southeast Asia, with a growing export ratio. It targets high-end functional and eco-friendly textile markets, including military, sports, medical, and lifestyle applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are based in Taiwan with sales primarily to Europe, America, and Southeast Asia. The company maintains domestic sales but increasingly focuses on direct exports to international markets. It also engages in local solar power generation in Taoyuan, Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream textile industry, focusing on fabric weaving, dyeing, finishing, and fabric trading. It acts as a key hub connecting upstream raw material suppliers (fibers, dyes, auxiliaries) and downstream garment manufacturers and apparel brands.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous upgrading of production processes and quality control, strengthening R&D for new processes and products, deepening collaboration with international brand customers, and promoting sustainable and low-carbon products. R&D focuses on non-mechanical brushed fabrics, TPEE elastic yarns, and textile-to-textile recycled yarns to reduce carbon footprint by about 80%.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of functional and dyed fabrics, dyeing processing services, and electricity sales from solar power plants. The company emphasizes high value-added product lines and customized manufacturing services to enhance profitability.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a high-value, differentiated supplier of functional and eco-friendly textiles, competing against other Taiwanese and international textile manufacturers. It leverages vertical integration and certifications like bluesign® and GRS to maintain competitive advantages and avoid price wars.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported net operating revenue of approximately NT$788 million, a 20.3% increase from the prior year, with net profit after tax of NT$97.3 million, nearly doubling from the previous year. The company shows steady growth in revenue and profitability, with improving asset and equity returns.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes sustainable, high-performance functional textiles with certifications ensuring environmental friendliness and consumer safety. It differentiates through innovative fabric structures, eco-friendly materials, and integration of smart manufacturing technologies, providing customers with comfortable, safe, and stylish textile solutions that meet evolving market demands.
